title: Putin votes online from his Kremlin office (18 Sep 2026)

source.note: Komsomolskaya Pravda upload of the Kremlin pool footage. Not redistributed here; new_project.py downloads it with yt-dlp.

start_note: Frames 0-139 (5.84 s) carry a loud Russian voice-over and a big location caption; starting at 140 skips both.

hand_tracking.note: One template per posture: he sits upright (A, B, D) or leans into the monitor (C). Between segments the hand is off the mouse, so speed is 0 there.

logo.note: KP.RU watermark = semi-transparent rounded box + opaque white glyphs, same place in both shots.

monitor.note: Whole panel of the real Dell monitor in the over-the-shoulder shot (static camera), TL, TR, BR, BL in source pixels. The bottom edge is the bottom of the dark Windows taskbar, NOT the bottom of the lit page — measured separately, because brightness thresholding stops at the taskbar.
